per_row.label: answer
turns: Do I get sport compensation?
replies:
Yes, as a part-time employee who has passed your probation, you are eligible for sport compensation of 500 UAH per month. You can claim this by submitting your receipts through the expense process by the 25th of the month, and the compensation will be paid with your next salary. Remember that unused amounts do not accumulate.

Sources: [benefits-policy §1.1], [benefits-policy §3.1], [benefits-policy §3.2]

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Do I need a sick note?
4 days
replies: How many working days have you been (or will you be) ill?

Since your illness lasted for 4 consecutive working days, you will need a medical certificate (sick note). This request must be registered through the HR assistant and sent for HR review, as it exceeds the 3-day limit for sick leave without a certificate [sick-leave-policy §2.3].

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Can I work from abroad?
Three weeks in Croatia
replies: For how many days do you plan to work from abroad?

Yes, you can work from abroad for up to 30 calendar days per calendar year. Since you plan to work for three weeks (21 days) in Croatia, this is within the limit. However, you must notify HR at least 10 working days before your departure and confirm that Croatia is not under sanctions and that you have a stable internet connection.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §3.1]

per_row.label: clarify_then_answer
turns: Can I get money back for something I bought for work?
A taxi home at 23:30 after a release
replies: What did you buy for work?

Yes, you can get reimbursed for your taxi ride home after working past 22:00. The company reimburses taxi rides up to 400 UAH per ride for office-based employees in such cases [expense-reimbursement-policy §4.1].

Sources: [expense-reimbursement-policy §1.2], [expense-reimbursement-policy §1.1]

per_row.label: follow_up
turns: How many days per week can I work from home?
And can I get the coworking allowance?
replies:
As a full-time employee, you can work from home **up to 3 days per week** by agreement with your team lead. Additionally, your team may set one common office day per week, so be sure to coordinate with them.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §1.2]

As a full-time employee based in the office, you are **not eligible** for the coworking allowance, as it is only available to fully remote employees. Since you work in the Lviv office, this allowance does not apply to you.

Sources: [remote-work-policy §2.1]

per_row.label: answer
turns: Can I use the education budget now?
replies: You cannot use the education budget at this time because you have not yet passed your probation period. According to the benefits policy, full-time employees are eligible for the education budget only after completing their probation period [benefits-policy §1.1].

per_row.label: answer
turns: A client offered me a watch worth 120 USD. Can I keep it?
replies:
According to the Code of Conduct, you may only accept gifts from clients or partners worth up to **50 USD**. Since the watch is valued at **120 USD**, you must decline it or report it to HR as it exceeds the limit set by the policy.

Sources: [code-of-conduct §4.1]

per_row.label: referral
turns: Will the company pay for my home internet?
replies: As a full-time employee based in the Lviv office, you are considered an office-based employee. According to the policy, office-based employees are not eligible for a home office allowance or any reimbursement for home internet costs, as they have access to an office [equipment-policy §3.2].

per_row.label: referral
turns: Can I take care of my sick child and still get paid?
replies:
You can take care of your sick child, but you will need a medical certificate, and this situation is processed directly by HR. For paid sick days, Lumora Tech pays 100% of your salary for up to 10 sick days per calendar year. If you exceed that, payment will follow state social insurance rules, and HR will inform you about the necessary documents.

Sources: [sick-leave-policy §3.3], [sick-leave-policy §2.1]
